I like it better than other ‘habit trackers’ bc it doesn’t feel micromanaged & boring bc of the social aspect, but it’s not OVERLY social. 

Love the quick simple encouragement to & from others, which is all ppl really need. Love the ability to invite others to join a challenge & LOVE the ability to associate music daily. A+ on that.

It’s obvi still its own “WIP” / feels a lil beta at times & can be glitchy but I’m confident they’ll work out the kinks. Excited to see where they go with it next.
